title: Fashion Consultant
description:
**About the role**

At EVOL, jewellery is personal. It’s something people choose to express themselves and wear as part of their everyday lives.

We’re looking for a Fashion Consultant who enjoys understanding people as much as they enjoy helping them find the right piece. You’ll introduce customers to our collections, guide them through their choices and create an experience that feels thoughtful, comfortable and personal.

**What you’ll do**

* Welcome walk-in and appointment-based customers, understand what they’re looking for and guide them through their choices.
* Present EVOL’s collections with confidence, sharing the design stories, materials and styling possibilities behind each piece.
* Help customers find jewellery that feels right for them, including personalised pieces and special orders.
* Build lasting relationships through thoughtful follow-ups, reminders and occasion-based communication.
* Work with the store team on displays, in-store activations and opportunities to introduce customers to pieces they may love.
* Coordinate custom orders, repairs, exchanges and after-sales service, keeping customers informed along the way.
* Handle billing, documentation and order entries accurately across digital and manual systems.
* Maintain the store’s visual standards, ensuring every counter reflects EVOL’s attention to detail.
* Support junior team members by sharing product knowledge, insights and best practices.
* Work towards individual and store sales targets while contributing to the team’s success.

**What we’re looking for**

* 1–4 years of experience in premium or luxury retail, or another customer-facing sales role. Experience in jewellery, fashion or lifestyle is preferred.
* The ability to listen, build rapport and turn conversations into lasting customer relationships.
* Strong communication skills, with fluency in English and Kannada. Hindi is a plus.
* Comfort using billing software, inventory systems and CRM tools.
* Availability to work on weekends and during key festive periods, with compensatory offs provided.
* A composed, thoughtful approach, even during busy periods.
* A genuine interest in jewellery, personal style and understanding what matters to customers.

**What you’ll gain**

* The opportunity to represent a modern, design-led fine jewellery brand.
* Ongoing training in jewellery, clienteling and retail.
* Performance-linked incentives and milestone bonuses.
* A structured path to grow into senior sales, training or store management roles.
* A team that values sincerity, consistency and thoughtful communication.

**Why EVOL?**

The best retail experiences stay with people long after they leave the store. At EVOL, you’ll have the opportunity to create those moments: helping someone discover a piece that feels like them, and building a relationship that lasts beyond the purchase.

**How to apply:**

If you're interested, please share your resume to hariom@evoljewels.com or 9154211354

title: Senior Engineer - Mobility & AMR
description:
**About CynLr**

Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see & pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link).

Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.

CynLr-enabled visual robots
*intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on-the-fly,*
eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into
*modular LEGO-like micro-factories*
that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.

At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
*deeply inspired by neuroscience,*
modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision-making, and action.

This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.

**About The Role**

A robot that cannot move is limited to the work that is brought to it. To take
**Object Intelligence**
into warehouses, factories and spaces built for people, our robots must travel, climb and carry.

Our first focus is mobility, which starts with
**mechanisms and body balance**
: joints, feet/wheels, mass distribution and centre of gravity decide what a platform can do long before software does.

Keeping a body stable through corners, oversteps and in tight spaces, while carrying a payload, is a
**whole-body control problem**
, and a bigger one than navigation. We need someone who knows this from experience: who has built a quadruped or similar platform and taken it into the real world.

**What You Will Do**

This role will involve the following

*Mechanisms and General Body Design:*

* General body design and component packaging
* Joint, Foot, spring powered actuations and balancing mechanisms
* Mechanical/Electrical actuation; actuator selection (QDD, harmonic, cycloidal, linear)

*Form Factor, Mass and CoG:*

* Mechanisms for poses and balancing
* Weight distribution, mass budget and centre-of-gravity management
* Stability in motion, including slanting and carrying payloads

*Body Balancing and Whole-body Control:*

* CoG and weight/balance compensation control
* Kinesthetics: awareness of the body’s posture, contacts and load
* Gait and whole-body control on multi-terrain and steps

*Navigation and Control:*

* Sensor fusion and visual odometry, with CynLr’s stereo vision as a primary sensor and other supporting sensors
* Environmental mapping, path planning and navigation planning
* Obstacle avoidance

*Safety Control:*

* Collision detection and avoidance
* Tight-space negotiation
* Tip-over and fall safety.

*Embedded, Motor Control and Learning:*

* Motor controllers with velocity and torque control
* Embedded control architecture for real-time locomotion
* Machine learning and RL-based locomotion with sim-to-real transfer

*Mobile manipulation:*
coordinating body motion with CyRo arms for pick-and-carry tasks and precise docking.

Working with Battery & Power on energy and weight, and mentoring junior engineers in the team.

**What Are We Looking For**

*Experience & Background:*

* **6–10 years**
  in robotics, with hands-on
  **quadruped**
  experience in design, build or deployment.
* At least one mobile platform
  **shipped or field-deployed**
  .
* A clear understanding that
  **whole-body control is a bigger problem than navigation**
  .
* Ability to work across mechanics, control and learning in a small, multidisciplinary team.

*Mechanical & Mechanism Design:*

* Strong in
  **general mechanical design**
  : structures, materials, stress/FEA, tolerancing and design for manufacturing.
* **Mechanism design**
  for joints, feet, poses and balancing, including spring-powered actuation.
* **Component packaging and form factor design**
  with tight control of weight distribution.

*Mobility Algorithms & Control:*

* **Motor control:**
  velocity and torque control of joint actuators
* Experience with Body balancing and CoG compensation, Gait and whole-body control (MPC or equivalent), Multi-terrain and stair locomotion
* Embedded control, C++, Python and ROS 2.
* Machine learning and RL for locomotion, with simulation in MuJoCo, Isaac Sim or Gazebo.

*Navigation & Safety:*

* Sensor fusion,
  **visual odometry**
  , environmental mapping, path planning and obstacle avoidance.
* Collision handling and tight-space negotiation.
* Awareness of mobile-robot safety standards:
  **ISO 3691-4, ANSI/A3 R15.08, UL 3100**
  .

*Good to Have:*

* Experience with AMR, AGV, omnidirectional wheel systems, quadrupeds, bipeds or wheel-legged systems.
* Actuator, motor or gearbox design experience.
* Fleet management.

**Team Structure & Growth**

You will join as one of the
**senior engineers in the Mobility vertical**
, in a core team of three:
**Mechanical Design, Mechanism & Control Design, and RL / Control**
. Together we will take the platform from prototype to manufacturable product, later extending to AMRs, bipeds and wheel-legged systems that carry our CLX vision and CyRo arms.

Beyond specializing in the role of Senior Engineer – Mobility & AMR, this position offers growth into
**leading CynLr’s mobile robotics line**
as the organisation scales. Paths include heading platform engineering across quadrupeds, bipeds, wheeled and hybrid robots, and shaping CynLr’s mobile manipulation products.

The role can also evolve into cross-functional and customer-facing opportunities such as product management for mobile platforms, field deployment and solution engineering, and research partnerships, based on individual interests and business needs.

*cool*

of the areas below rather than all of them, and we will train the rest.

We are currently consolidating three previously separate functions — promotions, content, and catalogue into a single operations team. The successful candidate will begin in their area of strength and be cross-trained across the remaining areas, making this well suited to someone looking to broaden their operational scope.

⁠
What is essential is the candidate should help drive optimize what we do today.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Promotions & Incentives Execution:**

* Configure and build promotions, offers, and incentive mechanics from approved market briefs, working to defined quality and turnaround standards.
* Manage the progression of all builds through non-production environments into production, ensuring environment-specific configuration is correctly applied.
* Support market teams through User Acceptance Testing, resolving defects raised within agreed timelines.
* Support go-live windows and monitor launched activity through the agreed stabilisation period.

**2. Content, Catalogue & Inventory Management:**

* Author, update, and publish consumer-facing content across the application and connected surfaces via the Content Management System.
* Create and maintain reward catalogue items, including bulk and batch loads for high-volume markets.
* Manage reward inventory within the Inventory Management System, including stock levels, allocation across markets, and the configuration of availability and out-of-stock behaviour.
* Monitor redemption against available inventory, and escalate depletion risk before a reward becomes unavailable to consumers.
* Maintain data accuracy and consistency across the platforms in scope — our catalogue management platform, the Content Management System, and the Loyalty Management System — ensuring the same reward is represented correctly in every system it appears in.
* Apply market-specific localisation requirements, including language, currency, and regional formatting standards.
* ⁠Manage the secure and critical process of code upload into the catalogue management system, ensuring the codes match the brief. The process handles PII data and therefore quality and governance are very critical.

**3. Quality Assurance & Release Readiness:**

* Validate all incoming briefs against the agreed Definition of Ready, and return incomplete or ambiguous briefs to the requesting team rather than proceeding to build.
* Design and execute test cases derived from acceptance criteria, covering edge cases and negative scenarios in addition to standard paths.
* Perform cross-device and cross-locale verification prior to production release.
* Log defects with clear, reproducible steps and supporting evidence.
* Participate in root cause analysis where a production issue is traced to a configuration or content error.

**4. Process, Documentation & Automation:**

* Develop, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures and runbooks for all recurring operational tasks, to a standard that allows a colleague outside the specialism to follow them.
* Identify repetitive manual activity and propose opportunities for simplification, elimination, or automation.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of intake, routing, and build processes across the consolidated team.
* Track and report individual throughput and quality metrics against agreed operational SLAs.

**5. Stakeholder Collaboration & Governance:**

* Act as an operational point of contact for Campaign, Product, Data, and Engineering teams on promotions, content, and catalogue matters.
* Escalate capacity constraints, brief quality issues, and delivery risks promptly and with a proposed course of action.
* Ensure all activity adheres to data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), security protocols, and internal governance standards.
* Support knowledge transfer and cross-training across the consolidated promotions, content, and catalogue functions.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

**Experience:**

* 3-5 years of progressive experience in Marketing Operations, Campaign Operations, Content Operations, E-commerce Operations, or a comparable build-and-configure role within a technology or MarTech environment.
* Experience configuring something that went live to real users, rather than working only in test or internal environments.
* Experience operating within defined SLAs in a request-driven, ticket-based environment.
* Experience in optimization and automation, so that we can drive operational excellence via tools.

**Core Capabilities — required of every candidate:**

* **Analytical reasoning:**
  The ability to move from a symptom to a root cause rather than working through a script. When something renders incorrectly or a load fails, you can form a hypothesis and test it.
* **Learning speed:**
  A demonstrable record of becoming productive on an unfamiliar platform quickly, and largely under your own direction. Two of our core systems are proprietary, so this matters more here than any specific tool on a CV.
* **Attention to detail under time pressure:**
  Most failures in this work are a small configuration difference that nobody checked.
* **Structured data fluency:**
  Comfort working with data in bulk — interpreting it, validating it, and spotting what looks wrong before it is loaded. Intermediate spreadsheet capability (lookups, pivots, data validation) is essential.
* **Quality ownership:**
  You test your own work and can articulate what you tested and why. There is no separate QA gate for this team.
* **Willingness to challenge:**
  The judgement and confidence to return an incomplete brief rather than building from it.
* **Written communication:**
  Clear written English. Most collaboration across our three regions happens in writing.
* **Automation**
  : Ability to identify improvements and drive operational excellence via tools and process changes.

**Platform Experience — strong hands-on experience in at least two of the following:**

* An enterprise Content Management System (e.g., Contentful, AEM) — content modelling, publishing workflows, environment management.
* A promotions engine, offers platform, or loyalty management system.
* A product, reward, or merchandise catalogue system — including bulk and batch loading.
* An inventory or stock management system — allocation, availability configuration, depletion and out-of-stock handling.
* A CRM or Customer Engagement Platform (e.g., Braze), or a marketing automation platform.
* An e-commerce platform with responsibility for product data or merchandising configuration.

**Technical Aptitude — any of the following will distinguish an application:**

* Reading and interpreting structured formats such as JSON or XML when diagnosing a configuration or rendering issue.
* Basic SQL for verifying data independently rather than requesting an extract.
* Scripting in any language to remove repetitive manual steps — Python, JavaScript, or similar.
* Working with APIs, webhooks, or integration behaviour between systems.
* Building or maintaining operational dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Mixpanel, Tableau).

**Operational Excellence:**

* Rigorous approach to quality assurance, with practical experience of test case design and execution against acceptance criteria.
* Experience developing and maintaining SOPs, runbooks, or process documentation.
* Exposure to incident management processes and participation in root cause analysis.
* Demonstrated attention to detail under time pressure, with the judgement to distinguish what must be escalated from what can be resolved independently.
